data.one_liner: Customizable alternative to InteractiveViewer with gesture, rotation, and keyboard controls
data.what_it_does: Provides a camera and input package for images, documents, maps, and diagrams. It supports mouse, touch, trackpad, wheel, and keyboard input, focal-point zoom, rotation, camera animation, and configurable bounds.
use_when: You need advanced zoom, rotation, and programmatic camera manipulation for images, maps, or diagrams.
You require keyboard navigation and precise viewport-based scene canvas control.
Flutter's standard InteractiveViewer does not meet your gesture or bounds constraints.
avoid_when: You only need standard, out-of-the-box pinch-to-zoom without extra customization.
Your project targets a version older than Flutter 3.41 or Dart 3.11.
strengths: Advanced keyboard navigation, gesture controls, and rotation support.
Programmatic transformations with a dedicated controller.
Viewport snapshots and coordinate conversion helpers for scene canvases.
weaknesses: Requires recent Flutter (3.41+) and Dart (3.11+) versions.
data.minimal_example:
CustomInteractiveViewer(
  child: Image.asset('assets/map.png'),
  zoomConfig: const ZoomConfig(minScale: .1, maxScale: 8),
)
